links.outcome: Association of LLM uncertainty measure with extraction failure and incremental discrimination
links.effect: LLM uncertainty strongly associated with extraction failure (adjusted OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57-6.69], P<0.001); AUC improved from 0.81 to 0.86 (ΔAUC +0.06, P=0.001).
links.quote: LLM uncertainty was strongly associated with extraction failure (adjusted OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57--6.69], $P<0.001$) and substantially improved discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity alone (AUC 0.81 to 0.86; $Δ$AUC $+0.06$ [$+0.03$, $+0.09$], $P=0.001$).

unlisted_practices: Using LLM uncertainty measures to attribute failures between extraction error and underlying clinical data discordance when building LLM-derived datasets
